data.title: They set fire to the archaeological open-air museum
data.excerpt: In the village of Prestavlky, history enthusiasts have been building a Slavic archaeological open-air museum on their own initiative, without support from the state and without any claim to a reward. On 28 March 2014, at the very time when they wanted to open the season, an unknown culprit set fire to one of the wooden buildings and to a large part of the prepared material.
data.metaTitle: Arson at the open-air museum in Prestavlky
data.metaDescription: An unknown culprit set fire to the Slavic open-air museum at Prestavlky, built by enthusiasts without state support, just as the season was to open.

children.text: Human stupidity knows no bounds. The latest case we are witnessing is in the village of Prestavlky, where history enthusiasts, without support from the state or any EU or other institutional funding, are building a Slavic archaeological open-air museum on their own initiative and without any claim to a reward.

On 28 March 2014, at the very time when they wanted to open the season, a shock awaited them on their arrival at the open-air museum. An unknown culprit had set fire to one of the wooden buildings and to a large part of the prepared material. He also damaged the other parts of the open-air museum.

But the saddest thing of all is the reaction and attitude of some of the local inhabitants, which could be summed up in the sentence: “Serves them right, they have no business dreaming up and building silly things here.”
